name: Cross Cut
description: A diagonal stroke drawn from shoulder to hip, the first cut every novice of the Order learns in the Birgu yards. Hits harder than a plain slash.

name: Pilgrim's Thrust
description: A straight lunge aimed at the seams between plates, taught to knights who walked to Jerusalem and back. The point pierces, ignoring part of the target's DEF.

name: Shieldbreaker
description: Both arms of the armatura drive one crushing blow down onto the foe's guard. Shakes the pilot inside, adding heavy fatigue on top of the damage.

name: Eight-Point Flurry
description: Two cuts traced like the arms of the eight-pointed cross, one rising and one falling. Strikes twice, each blow lighter than a full swing.

name: Last Rampart
description: A great two-handed overhead blow delivered as if holding the last breach at St Elmo. Only medium or heavy frames carry its weight; one of the Order's hardest strikes.

name: Shield Bash
description: The shield boss is rammed forward into the enemy's chest plate before they can set their feet. Leaves no opening to counter and tires the foe.

name: Bell-Ringer
description: A swinging mace blow to the helm that sets the whole harness ringing like the bells of San Lorenzo. Heavy damage and severe fatigue for the pilot struck.

name: Lance of Aragon
description: A short galloping rush with the polearm couched under the arm, in the manner of Aragonese jousters. Strong charge that reaches up to two tiles.

name: Hedge of Pikes
description: The pike is levelled and held firm, a single point standing for a whole Spanish square. A disciplined thrust that cannot be countered or answered.

name: Knight's Charge
description: The full weight of a medium armatura behind a lowered polearm, boilers roaring. A devastating charge from up to two tiles away.

name: Fisherman's Hook-Cut
description: A sharp curling cut learned gutting fish on the Marsaxlokk quays. A quick blade stroke that hits a little harder than a plain slash.

name: Żejtun Feint
description: A false step to one side, then two short cuts from the other, a trick of the Żejtun lanes. Strikes twice for light damage each.

name: Harvest Swing
description: A wide sweeping cut swung like a sickle through the summer wheat. Hits hard and leaves the target winded, adding fatigue.

name: Carob Split
description: A full overhead chop with the strength used to split carob logs. Slow to gather but one of the heaviest blows a militiaman can land.

name: Pitchfork Jab
description: A quick two-handed jab with the polearm from behind a field wall. Reaches up to two tiles away.

name: Brace and Drive
description: The butt is planted against the limestone and the point driven home as the foe comes on. Strong reach-two thrust that leaves no chance to counter.

name: Watchtower Sweep
description: A broad low sweep of the polearm, as the coastal watch fends off landing parties. Reaches two tiles and tires the target badly.

name: Aimed Shot
description: A slow, careful shot, matchlock braced and breath held until the moment is right. Far more accurate (+25%), ignores half the target's DEF and hits harder (x1.2).

name: Double Charge
description: The arquebus is loaded with a double measure of powder and ball, risking the barrel. A heavier shot than any normal volley.

name: Crossfire
description: Two quick shots from alternating firing positions behind the bastion parapet. Hits twice, each for reduced damage.

name: Sharpshooter
description: A patient shot aimed at the vision slit or a boiler joint. Hits hard and pierces, ignoring a large part of the target's DEF.

name: Crescent Slash
description: A curving draw-cut that follows the line of the kilij's blade. A clean strike, a little harder than a plain slash.

name: Janissary's Oath
description: A heavy overhead cut delivered with the full discipline of the Sultan's household infantry. Powerful single blow.

name: Twin Moons
description: Two crescent cuts in quick succession, one high and one low. Strikes twice for lighter damage each.

name: Sultan's Edge
description: A perfect drawing slash reserved for veterans in medium frames, aimed at joints and seams. Very heavy damage that pierces part of the target's DEF.

name: Steady Volley
description: A measured tüfek shot fired from a braced stance, as drilled in the ortas. A dependable standard shot.

name: Rolling Fire
description: Two shots in quick succession, a second barrel or a fast reload. Hits twice for reduced damage each.

name: Marksman of the Orta
description: A long-barrelled tüfek shot laid carefully on a weak point. Hits hard and pierces part of the target's DEF.

name: Sipahi Charge
description: A light armatura sweeps in at speed with lance lowered, in the manner of the provincial cavalry. A strong charge reaching up to two tiles.

name: Lance Feint
description: The lance tip dips as if to strike low, then darts high. A reach-two thrust that leaves no chance to counter.

name: Thunder of Hooves
description: Light frames gallop in at full speed and drive the lance through. A crushing charge from up to two tiles that leaves the target badly fatigued.

name: Fire Pot
description: A clay pot of burning naphtha is hurled to burst against the target's plates. Moderate damage and the heat tires the pilot inside.

name: Smoke and Iron
description: A bomb packed with iron scraps and thick smoke is lobbed at the foe. Modest damage, but the choking cloud adds heavy fatigue.

name: Burning Pitch
description: A cask of blazing pitch is flung to coat the armatura in fire. Heavy damage, and the heat in the cockpit causes heavy fatigue.

name: Boarding Slash
description: A quick cut delivered while leaping across a galley's rail. A nimble strike, slightly harder than a plain slash.

name: Deck Dance
description: Two light cuts made while dancing across a pitching deck. Strikes twice for reduced damage each.

name: Salt and Steel
description: A wide sweeping cut flung with the swing of a ship's boom. Hits hard and tires the target.

name: Barbary Reaper
description: A whirling full-body sweep of the blade, the signature of the Barbary raiders. Very heavy and pierces part of the target's DEF.

name: Grapple
description: An iron hook is thrown into the target's plates and hauled tight. Little damage, but it cannot be countered and badly tires the target.

name: Keelhaul
description: The armatura is hooked and wrenched off balance, then driven into the ground. Heavy blow that adds heavy fatigue.

name: Piston Strike
description: A steam piston fires the fist forward with a hiss and a crack. A strong blunt strike even for a weak pilot.

name: Steam Hammer
description: Valves open fully and the arm falls like a forge hammer. Very heavy damage that also adds heavy fatigue.

name: Overpressure
description: The boiler is pushed beyond its safe limit for one shattering blow. Immense damage that pierces part of the target's DEF.

name: Grapeshot
description: A charge of grapeshot is fired from a hull-mounted gun. Hits twice, each for reduced damage.

name: Siege Bolt
description: A heavy iron bolt is driven from a steam launcher. Hard-hitting and pierces part of the target's DEF.

name: Full Broadside
description: Every gun on a heavy machine fires at once in a single roar. Hits twice with heavy damage; only heavy frames carry enough guns.
